name: SP International website
start: if ! curl -sf -o /dev/null http://localhost:8080/; then nohup python3 -m http.server 8080 --directory /workspace > /tmp/static-server.log 2>&1 & fi; for i in $(seq 1 15); do curl -sf -o /dev/null http://localhost:8080/ && break; sleep 1; done; curl -sf -o /dev/null http://localhost:8080/

terminals.name: static-server-logs
terminals.description: Live request log for the static site served at http://localhost:8080 (started by the environment start command).
